posts.subject: DooDoo the great person
posts.bodyHtml:
I would like to give a doodoo such a great thank you, he has helped me become better player by talking to me about my behaviour and help me with soo many questions even the ridiculous ones, he has also been one of the kindest and respectull test-admin on the server also he is the most active on the knife server every time I play on the knife server I always see him play and answer some ridiculous I think he should become a full admin now as he has put in soo much time and effort into playing.


[herz2*] Doo Doo [herz2*]

Thank you Oxygen for the kind words, I hope that you are able to maintain your positive behaviour, if so, then I have no doubt you'd be a great attribute to the community and hopefully have a go at being a test-admin 🙂


Wish you the very best of luck


~Doo Doo [thanksforit*] [thanksforit*] 😄 😄

Sure I will maintain it doodoo, doing it just to make you happy and proud and I want to help the community as much as I possibly could, Good luck with future being a Admin wish you best man.
